Qt and PySide6 are dynamically linked, unmodified dependencies. This build uses Qt/PySide6 6.12.0.
The PySide6 wheel declares LGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only.
Source: https://code.qt.io/cgit/pyside/pyside-setup.git/ (v6.12.0) and https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/qtbase.git/ (v6.12.0).
The portable folder keeps Qt DLLs replaceable. Reticle authoring source is included separately.
Dependency-provided notices are copied to licenses/.
